newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar CEO targets 15 pct EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar CEO targets 15 pct EPS growth.

text.p: Independent refiner Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp is shooting for 15 percent annual earnings per share growth, Chief Executive Roger Hemminghaus said.
"We're trying to grow our internal earnings per share by 15 percent a year," Hemminghaus told Reuters Wednesday at the annual National Petroleum Refiners Association gathering.
He said Wall Street analysts estimate the company will earn between $2.40 and $2.50 per share this year.
On a proforma basis, that would be about $0.30 a share more than in 1996, when Ultramar and Diamond Shamrock merged into the Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp.

He noted that the company, which he said was committed to a growth strategy through acquistions of refining and retailing outlets, is shooting for the top three in its industry group in terms of total shareholder return.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk 1 212 859 1620
